implementation.note: implemented_in_code = a dedicated capability handler or tool directory exists; referenced_in_app_code = the entity is used by application source (e.g. repo-pet sprites, CLI) but has no dedicated handler. code_refs are files that reference this entity by name/slug/handler (grep), not a guarantee of a dedicated runtime; registry handler links point at the actual capability function.

proposed.command: mise roster run glaze-whisperer --dept operations-kitchen --solo --emit report
proposed.contract: inputs: base recipe / spec, ingredient batch, taste targets (salt, acid, umami), station order → outputs: finished base batch, tasting note, batch label with date and allergens; refuses to emit 'ready' unless the proof gate passes

lore: Most of the brigade only notices Glaze Whisperer when something is missing, which is exactly the point. Glaze Whisperer builds the base flavours other stations depend on: reductions, stocks and mother sauces that must taste the same every time; the image the crew uses for it is the back burner where the stockpots never go cold. The card calls out Glaze Control, Glaze Perfection, Shine Harmony: the checks Glaze Whisperer runs before calling anything ready. In the canon crosswalk this card is a provisional match for Garnish Ghost.
